How the lockdown works on phones

  • 🚫
    Questions can't be copiedText selection, long-press menus and copy shortcuts are blocked, so a question can't be carried into an AI chat app.
  • ⌨️
    Answers can't be pastedWritten answers must be typed. Paste is blocked and the attempt is logged.
  • 👀
    Leaving = a strikeSwitching apps or tabs, pressing Home, or leaving fullscreen is detected and time-stamped. At the limit, the exam submits itself.
  • 🧾
    Nothing is hidden from youEvery strike and blocked attempt appears in the student's final integrity report.

Honest note: a web page can't physically lock a phone the way school exam software on managed devices can. Used in class with these rules on screen, it stops casual copying and AI-pasting, and gives you a clear record of every attempt to leave. For a high-stakes exam, keep eyes on the room too.

Before you start

Exam

🤖 AI is cheating in this exam.

Using ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Google, a translator app, or any other app or website during the exam is cheating. This page watches for it and writes down the time of every attempt for your teacher.

  • 📴
    Do not leave this pageSwitching apps, opening another tab, or pressing Home counts as a strike. 3 strikes and your exam is submitted automatically.
  • 🚫
    No copying, no pastingQuestions cannot be copied out, and answers cannot be pasted in. Written answers must be typed by you.
  • ⏱️
    The timer does not stopWhen time runs out, your exam is submitted with the answers you have.
  • 🖨️
    No screenshots tricks, no printing, no right-clickThese are blocked or logged. Do your own work — that is the whole point.

📱 Phone checklist — do this now

  • ✓Close your other apps — especially AI apps, chat apps and the browser's other tabs.
  • ✓Turn on Do Not Disturb so calls and messages don't pop up and pull you out of the exam.
  • ✓Check battery & data/Wi-Fi — plug in if your battery is low, and stay connected.
  • ✓Keep this page open — do not press Home, do not swipe away, until you see your result.
  • ✓Sit where your teacher can see your screen.

Starting tries to open the exam in fullscreen. On iPhone, fullscreen is limited — the app-switch watch still protects your exam.
